title: Abyssals v0.90.20 — Clean Shiny Palettes

Smooth colour boundaries remove false black speckles on pale artwork. Combat, followers, atlas forms and menus share the correct palette; asynchronous summary portraits retain shiny and alternate-form identity. All 957 art surfaces audited across over 60 million visible pixels. Existing shiny ownership, rarity, saves, permanent deaths and quest outcomes preserved. Original Android signing key; automated source and browser checks, with no physical-phone testing.
